editorialSummary.heading: Early dismissal dates depend on school level
paragraphs: Clay County has separate early-dismissal schedules for elementary schools and for junior high and high schools. Elementary students dismiss early on September 18 and October 30, 2026, and February 12 and April 23, 2027. Junior high and high school students dismiss early on December 16-17, 2026, and May 25-26, 2027. Both groups dismiss early on December 18, 2026 and May 27, 2027. The district calendar does not give early-dismissal times, so check with your school about pickup and bus schedules.

Christmas/New Year’s break runs December 21, 2026-January 1, 2027, followed by a planning day on Monday, January 4. Students return Tuesday, January 5. In March, Friday the 19th is also a student holiday for planning. Spring break runs March 22-26, and students return March 29. Counting the weekends, they have March 19-28 off.

Friday, April 2, 2027 is Fair Day, a student and teacher holiday. Students attend March 29-April 1 after spring break, so Fair Day is a separate day off. The district lists graduation on May 21 but does not specify a final attendance day for seniors. The last student day is May 27, with early dismissal at both elementary and secondary schools. Final report cards are posted June 4. Families can check posted grades in Focus and contact their schools for pickup and graduation details.

faqs.question: When does Clay County school start and end in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The first day for students is Tuesday, August 11, 2026. The last day is Thursday, May 27, 2027, with early dismissal for elementary, junior high and high schools. The earlier August dates on the district calendar are for teachers.

faqs.question: What are the 2026-2027 elementary early-dismissal dates?
faqs.answer: Elementary schools dismiss early on September 18, October 30 and December 18, 2026, and February 12, April 23 and May 27, 2027. These dates do not automatically apply to junior high and high schools.

faqs.question: When do Clay County junior high and high schools dismiss early?
faqs.answer: Junior high and high schools dismiss early on December 16-18, 2026, and May 25-27, 2027. Only December 18 and May 27 are also elementary early-dismissal dates.

faqs.question: What time is early dismissal in Clay County schools?
faqs.answer: The student calendar names early-dismissal dates but does not provide pickup times. Check your child’s school notice and bus arrangements for the applicable date; regular school hours are not early-dismissal hours.

faqs.question: Do all Clay County elementary schools have the same hours in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: No. Most elementary schools are listed at 8:30 a.m.-2:42 p.m. for 2026-2027. McRae runs 8:45 a.m.-2:57 p.m.; Orange Park Elementary 7:45 a.m.-1:57 p.m.; and Rideout and Shadowlawn 8:20 a.m.-2:32 p.m. These are regular student hours, not early-dismissal times.

faqs.question: What are the regular junior high and high school hours in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The district’s 2026-2027 school-hours table lists 9:30 a.m.-3:42 p.m. for junior highs and 7:20 a.m.-1:40 p.m. for high schools, including Keystone Heights Jr/Sr High. Bannerman Learning Center has program-specific hours. Confirm your child’s campus schedule.

faqs.question: Is there school on October 12, 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, October 12 is a planning day and student holiday. Students return Tuesday, October 13. The first grading period ends October 9, which is not listed as a day off.

faqs.question: Are Labor Day, Veterans Day, MLK Day and Presidents Day school holidays?
faqs.answer: Yes. Labor Day (September 7, 2026), Veterans Day (November 11, 2026), Martin Luther King Jr. Day (January 18, 2027) and Presidents Day (February 15, 2027) are all student and teacher holidays.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break in Clay County in 2026?
faqs.answer: The district holiday runs Monday, November 23 through Friday, November 27, 2026. Including the weekends, students are out November 21-29 and are scheduled to return Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is Christmas break, and when do students return in January 2027?
faqs.answer: Christmas/New Year’s break is December 21, 2026-January 1, 2027. Monday, January 4 is a separate planning day with no student classes. Students return Tuesday, January 5.

faqs.question: When is Clay County spring break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring break is March 22-26, 2027. Friday, March 19 is also a student holiday for teacher planning. Including weekends, students have March 19-28 off and return Monday, March 29.

faqs.question: Is there school on Good Friday, March 26, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Good Friday, March 26, falls during the district’s March 22-26 spring break. It is not listed as a separate holiday on the 2026-2027 calendar.

faqs.question: Does Clay County have school on Fair Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Friday, April 2, 2027 is Fair Day, listed as a student and teacher holiday. Students are scheduled to attend March 29-April 1 after spring break, so Fair Day is not part of an uninterrupted extra week off.

faqs.question: When do the four grading periods end in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The grading periods end October 9 and December 18, 2026, and March 18 and May 27, 2027. December 18 and May 27 also have early dismissal for both elementary and secondary schools.

faqs.question: When are interim grades or progress reports posted?
faqs.answer: The district lists interim grades on September 11 and November 13, 2026, and February 5 and April 23, 2027. April 23 is also an elementary early-dismissal date; the posting date does not make it an early-dismissal day for secondary schools.

faqs.question: When are Clay County report cards posted in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The listed dates are October 16, 2026, and January 11, March 31 and June 4, 2027. The June 4 final posting is after the last student day; students do not return to school just to receive report cards.

faqs.question: Where can parents check Clay County grades and report cards?
faqs.answer: Clay County District Schools uses the Focus student information system for 2026-2027 grades and attendance. Visit the district’s Focus information page for parent access and sign-in help.

faqs.question: When is Clay County graduation in 2027?
faqs.answer: The district student calendar lists graduation on Friday, May 21, 2027. It does not give school-by-school ceremony times or a separate last attendance day for seniors. Ask your high school about exams, rehearsal and checkout requirements.

faqs.question: How many student attendance days are scheduled in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The four grading periods have 43, 43, 51 and 43 student days, totaling 180. This total is calculated from the district’s published schedule; it is not a separately printed annual total.

faqs.question: Are hurricane or weather make-up days listed for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The published student calendar does not name specific weather make-up dates or a reserve-day order. Check district announcements if weather causes a schedule change.

faqs.question: Where can I find and print the official 2026-2027 Clay County school calendar?
faqs.answer: Open the “26-27 Student Calendar” on the Clay County District Schools Student Calendars page. The district links to a Google document that you can view, print or download. Check district and school notices for later changes.

faqs.question: Which teacher planning days are student holidays in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: October 12, 2026, and January 4 and March 19, 2027 are planning days with no student classes. Students return October 13, January 5 and March 29, respectively. The March return follows the separate March 22-26 spring break.

faqs.question: Does Clay County have a fall break in 2026?
faqs.answer: The 2026-2027 student calendar does not list a separate fall break week. Students have Monday, October 12 off for a planning day and return Tuesday, October 13. The next full-week holiday is Thanksgiving break, November 23-27.

faqs.answer: Yes. Friday, April 14, 2028 is listed as Good Friday, a student and teacher holiday. It is one week after Fair Day on April 7; April 10-13 are not scheduled holidays.

faqs.question: When do the grading periods end in 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: The four grading periods end October 8 and December 17, 2027, and March 10 and May 26, 2028. December 17 and May 26 also have early dismissal for elementary and secondary students.

faqs.question: When are interim grades or progress reports posted in 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: Interim grades are scheduled for September 10 and November 12, 2027, and February 4 and April 21, 2028. These dates are not listed as early-dismissal days.

faqs.question: When are Clay County report cards posted in 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: Report cards are scheduled for October 15, 2027, and January 7, March 24 and June 9, 2028. June 9 is after the May 26 last student day; it is not another day of classes.

faqs.question: When is graduation in Clay County in 2028?
faqs.answer: The district calendar lists graduation on Friday, May 19, 2028. It does not specify every high school’s ceremony time or a separate final attendance day for seniors. Confirm senior exams, rehearsals and ceremony details with your school.

faqs.question: How many student attendance days are scheduled in 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: The four grading periods list 43, 43, 47 and 47 student days, totaling 180. The total is derived from the published calendar, not printed as a separate annual figure.

faqs.question: Does the 2027-2028 calendar list weather make-up days?
faqs.answer: The student calendar does not name specific hurricane or weather make-up dates or an order for using them. Check district announcements for any later change.

faqs.question: Where can I find and print the official 2027-2028 Clay County school calendar?
faqs.answer: Open the “27-28 Student Calendar” on the district’s Student Calendars page. The linked Google document can be viewed, printed or downloaded. Check district and school announcements for later revisions.

faqs.question: Which teacher planning days are student holidays in 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes on October 11, 2027, January 3, 2028 and March 20, 2028. These are planning days. Classes resume October 12, January 4 and March 21, respectively.

faqs.question: Does Clay County have a fall break in 2027?
faqs.answer: The 2027-2028 student calendar does not list a separate fall break week. Monday, October 11 is a planning day with no student classes, and students return Tuesday, October 12. Thanksgiving break runs November 22-26.
